name: Breathruin
description: Ties each breath to the hawk's stillness so the aim holds as the lungs empty and the finger takes up the slack.

name: Remnant Rearsight
description: Levels the eye against the horizon so the rifle is never canted by a hair before a long shot.

name: Mangling Cheekrest
description: Beds both elbows into hollows of the rim stone so that the bone, not the muscle, carries the rifle.

name: Boltglimmer
description: Climbs a broken ridge on the outer edges of the feet, testing each stone before it takes weight.

name: Verity Magazine
description: Pulls the whole qi sense into a narrow beam behind the eyes until a distant target seems to stand within arm's length.

name: Glamour Bolt
description: Draws the field tight about lock and muzzle so that the report sounds dull and its direction is hard to judge.

name: Vengeful Zero
description: Reads warm air lifting off sunlit rock and raises the point of aim to allow for the lift on a long ball.

name: Scopescourge
description: Holds a high perch and a held aim, then drops a single shot downward that splits plate and the guard beneath it.

name: Adamantine Buttpad
description: Wraps the field about the rock ledge where the shooter lies so that shot and splinters turn aside.

name: Merciless Nova Reticle
description: Ties field and sight to one target point, then looses a shot that holds its line to full reach and pierces a guard.

name: Aura Squeeze
description: Stands shoulder to shoulder with a partner, outer feet planted, so that two barrels point the same way without crowding.

name: Chime Bolt
description: Reads a partner's low hand signs at the edge of vision and fires or holds as they direct.

name: Bipodblink
description: Drops to cover beside a partner on one shared count so that neither is left standing alone.

name: Booming Longshot
description: Fires the instant the partner fires, qi matching the two shots so that they strike as one blow.

name: Gust Cheekrest
description: Steps to the partner's far side as he fires, so that the enemy's reply falls on the empty place.

name: Numbing Rearsight
description: Fires on the exact beat of an opponent's qi breath to scatter the technique he was gathering.

name: Sighthavoc
description: Joins two fields so that two lines of fire converge on a single spot and keep it unbearable to stand in.

name: Scopemettle
description: Crosses two barrels before the pair to meet a heavy blow with doubled iron and joined fields.

name: Hollowzero
description: Two shooters hold one aim in joined fields and loose their shots in the same instant, driving a single path through a guard.

name: Zeroglare
description: Slides down the reverse slope of the rim to cover as soon as the shot is away.

name: Pitiless Cheekrest
description: Draws the cheek to the stock in a single sweep while the eye is already on the target below.

name: Clear Magazine
description: Counts the pause between a shout and its return off the far rim to judge the distance across the floor.

name: Ghosting Chamber
description: Moves along a dry stream bed below the line of the banks, rifle carried at the trail.

name: Granite Bipod
description: Lies head-up on a steep slope with the boots dug in so that the whole body acts as a rest.

name: Mayhem Rearsight
description: Fires so that its report is thrown from a distant wall by the shape of the basin, sending the enemy toward the wrong rim.

name: Hellish Longshot
description: Allows for the first ball from a cold barrel landing a little differently from the rest and aims off to meet it.

name: Waning Scopemount
description: Throws a thread of the field across the basin to a partner on the opposite rim and shares what each can see.

name: Bolthavoc
description: Rakes the whole floor of the basin with measured fire from the rim until no one dares to cross it.

name: Confluent Breath
description: Fires, leaps to the next rim stone and fires again, so that two shots seem to come from two shooters.

name: Ironsight
description: Gathers the whole field into a single downward shot from the crest of the basin that pierces a guard at the bottom.

name: Punishing Zero
description: Sets both feet on flat river stones so that the stance stays solid however the current tugs.

name: Berserk Reticle
description: Spreads the elbows wide like a hawk's wings to make a broad base under the barrel.

name: Sightvortex
description: Parts the reeds with the barrel's tip and closes them behind as the shooter passes through.

name: Chime Chamber
description: Lowers the brow and narrows the eyes against the glare off the river to keep the sights clear.

name: Torrent Buttpad
description: Tests each wet stone with the toe and shifts the weight only when it bears a firm footing.

name: Gnashing Squeeze
description: Lets qi rise and fall in the arms to the steady beat of the current until the trigger breaks between two pulses.

name: Remnant Cheekrest
description: Studies buckles and plate edges for the point where the armour is thinnest and marks it for the shot.

name: Glint Longshot
description: Primes the second track of qi along the bore just before firing so that the ball bites hard at the first touch.

name: Vanishing Chamber
description: Slips downstream on the bank with the current's pace so that the shooter's track fades from sight.

name: Breathwrath
description: Fires from a high bank down across the water, qi gathered in the ball so it plunges onto the mark and pierces.

name: Unsparing Rifling
description: Lays unhurried shot after shot along a river crossing so that the far bank falls silent and no head rises.

name: Lacerating Zero Reckoning
description: Sends a single shot across the river on a joined hawk-dive and current-beat of qi that pierces a guard and breaks the target's focus.

name: Aura Rifling
description: Passes a slow breath of qi along the length of the barrel from lock to muzzle before the first shot.

name: Nimbus Rearsight
description: Draws the field slowly out from the skin to the full reach of the arms and holds it there.

name: Decimating Magazine
description: Counts powder on one beat and ball on the next, the two never overlapping in a single motion.

name: Remnant Buttpad
description: Runs the thumb over lock, flint and pan before every shot to feel for a fault the eye would miss.

name: Zeroflash
description: Alternates three paces of advance with a rested halt so that the aim is always taken from a still body.

name: Corroding Bolt
description: Keeps one track of qi on the target and another on the rifle, each correcting the other until the shot is free.

name: Rumble Rifling
description: Sets a hum of qi along the barrel as the shot leaves, unsettling the qi guard of the one it strikes.

name: Boltvalor
description: Throws the second track of qi down the rifle to knock a blade off its line without moving the feet.

name: Aegis Scopemount
description: Draws the field close around the shoulders and trunk like a cloak that dulls the force of glancing blows.

name: Shattering Reticle
description: Joins the aim track and the driving track in one burst at the moment of firing so that the ball bores through.

name: Zeroscourge
description: Walks forward with one track holding the rifle level and the other driving the loading hand, firing at each pause.

name: Overlapping Squeeze
description: Parries a blow on the barrel track, swaps tracks, and fires from the hip in a single continuous answer.

name: Rumblebolt
description: Keeps the aim, barrel and body tracks unbroken from the first breath to the last, and sends one flawless shot through a guard.

name: Verity Cheekrest
description: Keeps watch as the light grows, noting each shape that was not there at dusk.

name: Sightglimmer
description: Paces the top of a wall on the soft balls of the feet with the rifle slung and ears open.

name: Wrathful Longshot
description: Fires one shot high over the approach so that none is hurt but every sleeper in the post is roused.

name: Remnant Magazine
description: Reads the faint outline of a front bead against a darker sky by letting the field sharpen the eye.

name: Grievous Rifling
description: Marks a stretch of the road with the eye and keeps it under fire so that no party can pass.

name: Boltnerve
description: Plants the butt, angles the barrel and braces with qi so that a rush meets iron and the bayonet.

name: Lethal Rearsight
description: Lashes a loaded rifle to a stake aimed along a path, a thread of qi on the trigger so a walker fires it.

name: Rampaging Chamber
description: Fires from a battlement in a constant rhythm so that the wall seems to be manned by many.

name: Regal Reticle
description: Waits until the last dusk light lies on the mark, then sends a held shot that bores through a guard.

name: Zeroruin
description: Waits on a high perch with the rifle across the knees until the mark enters the sights.

name: Scopeblink
description: Drops from ledge to ledge with arms folded close to the body, landing lightly on the balls of the feet.

name: Might Bipod
description: Grips the wrist of the stock like a hawk gripping a branch, firm yet loose enough to feel the recoil.

name: Wary Bolt
description: Watches dust and feathers drifting upward from a cliff face to learn how the air lifts a falling ball.

name: Headlong Buttpad
description: Slips sideways along a narrow ledge with the shoulder grazing the rock and the rifle held in.

name: Hellish Squeeze
description: Lowers the point of aim by a measured amount for a steep downward shot, the ball falling less than flat ground suggests.

name: Overpowering Sight
description: Takes a firing place with the sun at the back so that the enemy looks into its glare and cannot find the shooter.

name: Unbowed Cheekrest
description: Sweeps the barrel across the body in a wide beat like a wing to turn a thrown spear.

name: Sightwrath
description: Gathers qi in a held aim from the highest perch and sends the ball down the long fall like a stooping hawk.

name: Torrential Rearsight
description: Springs back up the slope on qi-lifted legs after the shot, reaching the perch before the answering fire arrives.

name: Aurascope
description: Gathers field and sight from a lofty perch and sends a single diving shot that holds its line and bores through a qi guard.
